content.summary: The published certificate inequality survives algebraic scrutiny and bounded exact tests. Fresh centrally scheduled tests of the frozen Q8 coverage checker reject missing coverage, forward/self dependencies, equality at the target, zero scale and an unjustified proper-trace inference. The original 94-leaf plan passes. No counterexample to these inspected mechanisms was found; full coefficient-model and whole-proof correctness remain broader obligations.

findings.statement: The coefficient replayer can report PASS when its arithmetic matches but its bound is non-strict. Its strict_exclusion field and conclusion distinguish that case. Therefore PASS alone is not an exclusion certificate.
findings.disposition: The active stage-plan checker separately requires a strict integer comparison and strict_exclusion=true. The manuscript already warns against treating solver status or equality as exclusion; retain this distinction.

findings.statement: Fresh stage-plan validation tests literal coverage and receipt commitments; it does not rebuild the coefficient models or independently prove their mathematical row premises.
findings.disposition: The round's new execution is limited to the frozen standard-library coverage checker and isolated controls. No unfrozen replay wrapper was used as evidence.

checks.scope: Exact certificate algebra and all-coordinate correction
checks.method: Derived the inequality from q.z<=H and the coordinate box maxima; inspected replay_degree17_full_v9.py lines1470-1588; tested 1000 deterministic small integral models and all1806 feasible box points encountered.
checks.observation: All tested feasible points satisfy the published bound. The code checks matrix shapes, integer model entries, positive integer scale, nonnegative inequality weights and signed equality weights, then accumulates with Python integers over every box coordinate. A concrete omission counterexample is x-s<=0 with x,s in[0,1], objective x: the full correction gives1, while omitting the selector correction falsely gives0 at feasible point(1,1). The actual code includes this coordinate. Results are retained in /tmp/r67_data_round03/algebra.json; the tests supplement the algebraic derivation.

checks.scope: Complete Q8 marker-domain baseline and missing-leaf control
checks.method: With central scheduling, executed the frozen check_d17_stage_plan_v9.py via its check function on an unchanged copy of the bound plan, then removed its final mixed-three node and tested complete and explicit partial modes.
checks.observation: The baseline passes with94 leaves and zero missing domains. Removing the final node is rejected in complete mode. Partial mode reports93 leaves, three missing mixed triples, PASS_D17_PARTIAL_STAGE_FACTS_ONLY and terminal.applicable=false. The source plan remained byte-identical. Fresh results and the exact driver are in /tmp/r67_data_round03/results.json and check_controls.py.

checks.scope: Sibling dependency, self-dependency and proper-trace adversarial controls
checks.method: Executed isolated plan mutations adding E4_57 as a predecessor of earlier E4_56, adding a node's own ID to its predecessors, and adding forbidden mixed-triple mask67 to E4_56 while only four-set facts were available.
checks.observation: The first two mutations fail the strictly-earlier predecessor rule. The third fails with unproved forbidden trace67. Separately, the actual E4_56/E4_57 records have exactly the same68 predecessors and neither names the other. These tests address circular sibling use and the invalid inference from absent four-sets to absent proper traces.

checks.method: Changed the E3_00 receipt in an isolated copy to have exact numerator51D, preserving numerator=H+correction, and separately changed its scale to0; updated the copied receipt commitment so the test reached the semantic certificate guard. Also tested integer thresholds51D-1,51D,51D+1 at D=10^10.
checks.observation: The frozen coverage checker rejects both equality and zero scale with Leaf lacks a strict certificate. Exact comparison excludes only51D-1, not equality or51D+1. The coefficient replayer ignores numerical_display and records strict_exclusion separately from arithmetic PASS. No rounded optimum is needed by the inspected exclusion mechanism.

checks.scope: Frozen Round 3 identity and scope preservation
checks.method: Verified manuscript byte hash and canonical snapshot hash; read the frozen role, contract, source-map references and revised certificate/coverage sections.
checks.observation: Both supplied hashes match. The manuscript retains arbitrary exterior multiplicities, whole-orbit facts, the shared-builder disclosure and the strict-target requirement. This round executed no solver, producer build, coefficient replay or compiler; its centrally allocated run took about2.3 seconds and the slot was released.
